name: google-ads-pro
title: Google Ads pro
description: Writes Google search ads from the advertiser's own search term report or Keyword Planner ideas: the searches that convert, wasted spend, negatives that block it without blocking a sale, ad groups by theme with match types, headlines that cover the demand, and a before-and-after score.
data_policy: Runs on your computer. Your reports and ads never leave it; only the copy you approve goes to your AI model through MangoMan.
